articles.blurb: Agent swarms are groups of agents that work together to accomplish a task. Researchers created an experiment in which eight agents from four different models worked together to resolve simulated outages to understand how agents organize themselves in a swarm without a designated leader. They discovered two factors that could influence an agent's potential leadership: the agent's underlying models, and the order in which their name was listed in a prompt. articles.headline: More Americans Have Tried Crypto, But Few Are Sticking With It
articles.blurb: A survey of 1,545 US adults, commissioned by the DeFi Education Fund, shows lifetime crypto ownership rising to 22% from 18%, yet active past-year usage held flat at 13%, pointing to a retention problem more than an awareness gap. The lifetime figure grew because lapsed users returned: among respondents who had not used crypto in the past year, 11% reported prior ownership, up from 5% a year ago, while new-user entry did not accelerate. Trust in crypto exchanges (4% high trust) and decentralized platforms (5%) sits far below the 42-48% high-trust ratings earned by banks and credit unions, and DeFi familiarity registers at just 2% "very familiar." Despite the GENIUS Act establishing federal stablecoin rules, stated interest in learning about stablecoins fell to 7% from 11%, and DeFi interest dropped to 8% from 11%, showing that regulatory clarity has not translated into consumer engagement.

The Federal Reserve's hawkish hold at 3.75-4% added pressure, with Chair Kevin Warsh citing persistent inflation and ING forecasting a December rate hike following September's increase. $356 million in crypto futures liquidated over 24 hours, including $205 million from long positions, with BTC futures accounting for $94 million and ETH for $72 million. Elevated real yields reduce the speculative capital pool, and a December Fed hike would tighten that constraint into year-end.
